name: Mint Condition
source:
Mint is a girl made of chocomint ice cream, and just so happens to be a creamer(y) streamer!  She's been working on a new batch of her mint flavored ice cream, and she'll be taste testing it with a special guest!

[From [url=https://makevisualnovels.itch.io/mint-condition]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
明特是一位由薄荷巧克力冰淇淋化身的少女，同时还是一名甜品屋冰淇淋主播！她最近刚调制出一批全新的薄荷味冰淇淋，正准备与一位特别嘉宾一起现场试吃品鉴！

[摘自[url=https://makevisualnovels.itch.io/mint-condition]itch.io[/url]]
